correctness.rationale: Block-form reconstruction of every algebra map shows that a nonzero central multiplier forces an invertible quotient projection and hence identity; zero multiplier yields exactly graph images of product-zero subspaces. Goursat data parameterize all such subspaces uniquely; complementary-kernel and graph-functional counts prove coefficients and boundary cases over any finite field. Independent brute-force matrix checks in dimensions 3 and 5, plus subspace enumerations through n=3 and GF(4), agree.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A prior count of Lie retractions or group retractions would dominate the present claim only if it also counted the product-zero subspaces and their specified-image fibers. Neither the inspected general brace papers nor the previously known Lie normal-form statement supplies the ordered pairing restriction or the Gaussian Goursat multiplicities. A general formula for radical-ring homomorphism images could dominate, but none was found in checked sources.

originality.rationale: Full relevant portions of three primary brace/group-endomorphism papers were compared by statements, objects, and implications. Their nilpotency/factorization/group-to-brace conclusions do not contain the ordered product-zero Goursat rank census. The known Heisenberg Lie rank classification imposes weaker alternating isotropy and cannot by itself supply these coefficients; older radical-ring/bilinear enumeration remains a residual risk. Novelty is assessed within inspected coverage, not claimed as exhaustive or independently established.
residual_risks: Older general classifications of bilinear-square nilpotent associative rings, product-zero subspaces, or radical braces may imply this rank census without matching terminology.
Publisher full text for the upper-triangular semiring paper was not inspected; the abstract assumptions are inapplicable, but assessment is correspondingly limited.
Result database and web search coverage is incomplete; lack of a matching result is not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of noncommutative radical braces has its full rank- and image-resolved retraction invariant determined. The sharp missing rank interval, uniform specified-image fibers, and Goursat convolution for ordered product-zero subspaces reveal constraints invisible in the associated Heisenberg Lie or circle group alone. The theorem treats all n and finite fields and cannot be reduced to a single small table.
